8	/-!
9	# Pullback preserves quasi-coherence (Stacks 01BG, general morphism)
10	
11	For an arbitrary morphism of schemes `g : Y ⟶ X` and a quasi-coherent
12	`F : X.Modules`, the module pullback `g^* F = (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F`
13	is quasi-coherent (`pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom`).  This generalizes the
14	open-immersion case `isQuasicoherent_pullback_opens` (`CechTermAcyclic.lean`);
15	the previously-documented obstruction — `SheafOfModules.Presentation.map` only
16	transports a *global* presentation while quasi-coherence is *local* — is resolved
17	by localizing the pullback itself: over each member `U` of the quasi-coherence
18	cover of `X`, the restriction of `g^* F` to the preimage `W = g⁻¹(U)` is the
19	pullback of `F|_U` along the restricted morphism `g.resLE U W : W ⟶ U`
20	(the pullback pseudofunctor square `resLE_comp_ι`), and the *global* presentation
21	of `F|_U` transports along that restricted pullback.
22	
23	Two supporting facts are proved on the way:
24	
25	* `opensMap_final`: for any continuous map `φ`, the preimage functor
26	  `Opens.map φ` on opens is `Final` — the costructured comma poset
27	  `{U // d ≤ φ⁻¹(U)}` is nonempty (`⊤`) and `⊔`-directed, hence filtered.
28	* `pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso_hom`: consequently Mathlib's unit comparison
29	  `pullbackObjUnitToUnit` is an isomorphism for the module pullback along *any*
30	  scheme morphism, i.e. `g^* 𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y` (`pullbackUnitIso`).
31	
32	These feed the flat-base-change RHS tilde leaf
33	`pushPullObj_coverInter_baseChanged_pushforward_iso_tilde`
34	(`CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean`), which needs quasi-coherence of the
35	base-changed module `g'^* F` to apply the altitude-2 bridge
36	`pushPullObj_pushforward_iso_tilde` on the base-changed side.
37	-/
38	
39	universe u
40	
41	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
42	
43	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace
44	
45	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
46	
47	open Scheme.Modules
48	
49	/-! ## Finality of the opens-preimage functor -/
50	
51	/-- The costructured comma category `StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)` — the poset of opens
52	`U` of the target with `d ≤ φ⁻¹(U)` — is filtered: it is nonempty (`U = ⊤`) and closed
53	under binary joins (`φ⁻¹` is monotone and preserves `⊔`), and it is thin, so parallel
54	pairs are automatically equalized. -/
55	instance opensMapStructuredArrow_isFiltered {T T' : TopCat.{u}} (φ : T ⟶ T')
56	    (d : Opens T) : IsFiltered (StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)) := by
57	  haveI hne : Nonempty (StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)) :=
58	    ⟨StructuredArrow.mk (Y := ⊤) (homOfLE (fun x _ => trivial))⟩
59	  haveI hfe : IsFilteredOrEmpty (StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)) := by
60	    constructor
61	    · intro j₁ j₂
62	      refine ⟨StructuredArrow.mk (Y := j₁.right ⊔ j₂.right)
63	          (j₁.hom ≫ (Opens.map φ).map (homOfLE le_sup_left)),
64	        StructuredArrow.homMk (homOfLE le_sup_left) rfl,
65	        StructuredArrow.homMk (homOfLE le_sup_right) (Subsingleton.elim _ _), trivial⟩
66	    · intro j₁ j₂ f g
67	      exact ⟨j₂, 𝟙 j₂, by apply StructuredArrow.hom_ext; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
68	  constructor
69	
70	/-- **The opens-preimage functor of any continuous map is final.**  Consequently global
71	sections of a pushforward along any scheme morphism compare correctly, and the module
72	pullback of the structure sheaf is the structure sheaf (`pullbackObjUnitToUnit` is an
73	isomorphism, Mathlib's `[F.Final]` instance in `PullbackFree.lean`). -/
74	instance opensMap_final {T T' : TopCat.{u}} (φ : T ⟶ T') : (Opens.map φ).Final :=
75	  Functor.final_of_isFiltered_structuredArrow _
76	
77	/-- **`g^* 𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y` for an arbitrary scheme morphism**: the unit comparison of the
78	module pullback along any scheme morphism is an isomorphism (the underlying site functor
79	`Opens.map g.base` is final by `opensMap_final`). -/
80	instance pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso_hom {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) :
81	    IsIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom) :=
82	  inferInstance
83	
84	/-- The structure-sheaf unit iso `g^* 𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y` for an arbitrary scheme morphism,
85	packaged for `Presentation.map`. -/
86	noncomputable def pullbackUnitIso {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) :
87	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅
88	      SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf :=
89	  @asIso _ _ _ _ _ (pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso_hom g)
90	
91	/-! ## The per-slice presentation of a pullback -/
92	
93	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
94	/-- **The per-slice presentation of a pullback**: a presentation of `F.over A` induces a
95	presentation of the slice `(g^* F).over (g ⁻¹ᵁ A)`, for an arbitrary scheme morphism
96	`g : Y ⟶ X`.
97	
98	Route: let `W := g ⁻¹ᵁ A` and `gA := g.resLE A W : W ⟶ A` the restricted morphism.  The
99	X-side bridge (`presentationRestrictOfOver` at `W := A`) presents the full restriction
100	`F.restrict A.ι`; the restricted pullback `(pullback gA)` transports it
101	(`Presentation.map`, unit iso by `pullbackUnitIso`); the pullback pseudofunctor square
102	`gA ≫ A.ι = W.ι ≫ g` (`resLE_comp_ι`) identifies `(pullback gA).obj (F.restrict A.ι)`
103	with `(g^* F).restrict W.ι`; the V-side bridge engine (`modulesOverOpensEquivalence`
104	over `Y`) carries the presentation back to the over-slice. -/
105	noncomputable def presentationPullbackSliceOfOver {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
106	    (F : X.Modules) (A : X.Opens) (P : (F.over A).Presentation) :
107	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F).over (g ⁻¹ᵁ A)).Presentation := by
108	  set W : Y.Opens := g ⁻¹ᵁ A with hW
109	  set G : Y.Modules := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F with hG
110	  -- X-side: present the full restriction to `A`.
111	  letI P1 : (F.restrict A.ι).Presentation := presentationRestrictOfOver A F A P le_rfl
112	  -- The restricted morphism `W ⟶ A`.
113	  letI gA : W.toScheme ⟶ A.toScheme := g.resLE A W le_rfl
114	  -- Transport the presentation along the restricted pullback (colimit-preserving; unit ↦ unit).
115	  haveI hpc : Limits.PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u, u, u, u + 1, u + 1}
116	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback gA) := inferInstance
117	  letI P2 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback gA).obj (F.restrict A.ι)).Presentation :=
118	    @SheafOfModules.Presentation.map _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ P1
119	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback gA) hpc (pullbackUnitIso gA).symm
120	  -- Identify with the restriction of the global pullback via the pseudofunctor square.
121	  have heq : gA ≫ A.ι = W.ι ≫ g := Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι g le_rfl
122	  letI e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback gA).obj (F.restrict A.ι) ≅ G.restrict W.ι :=
123	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback gA).mapIso
124	        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback A.ι).app F) ≪≫
125	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp gA A.ι).app F ≪≫
126	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr heq).app F ≪≫
127	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp W.ι g).app F).symm ≪≫
128	      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).app G).symm
129	  letI P5 : (G.restrict W.ι).Presentation :=
130	    SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u, u, u} e.hom P2
131	  -- V-side: carry the restriction presentation back to the over-slice through the engine.
132	  letI eV := modulesOverOpensEquivalence (X := Y) W
133	  letI P6 : (eV.inverse.obj (G.over W)).Presentation :=
134	    SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u, u, u}
135	      (overOpensIsoRestrict W G).symm.hom P5
136	  letI ηV : eV.functor.obj (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) ≅
137	      SheafOfModules.unit (Sheaf.over Y.ringCatSheaf W) :=
138	    overOpensFunctorUnitIso (X := Y) W
139	  letI P7 : (eV.functor.obj (eV.inverse.obj (G.over W))).Presentation :=
140	    P6.map eV.functor ηV.symm
141	  exact SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u, u, u}
142	    (eV.counitIso.app (G.over W)).hom P7
143	
144	/-! ## Pullback preserves quasi-coherence -/
145	
146	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
147	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
148	-- Cover-local quasi-coherence repeatedly synthesizes right adjoints through the
149	-- presentation transport; the default instance and elaboration budgets time out.
150	set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
151	/-- **Pullback preserves quasi-coherence** (Stacks 01BG, general-morphism case).  For an
152	arbitrary morphism of schemes `g : Y ⟶ X` and a quasi-coherent `F : X.Modules`, the module
153	pullback `g^* F` is quasi-coherent.
154	
155	Quasi-coherence is local (`SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop`): the preimages
156	under `g` of the quasi-coherence cover of `X` cover `Y`, and over each preimage the
157	per-slice obligation is `presentationPullbackSliceOfOver`. -/
158	theorem pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
159	    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherent) :
160	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F).IsQuasicoherent := by
161	  obtain ⟨⟨q⟩⟩ := hF
162	  -- The preimages of the quasi-coherence cover of `X` cover `Y`.
163	  have hcov : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop
164	      (fun i => g ⁻¹ᵁ q.X i) := by
165	    intro W x hx
166	    obtain ⟨U', fU, hf, hU'⟩ := q.coversTop ⊤ (g.base x) (by trivial)
167	    obtain ⟨i, ⟨gi⟩⟩ := hf
168	    refine ⟨W ⊓ (g ⁻¹ᵁ q.X i), homOfLE inf_le_left, ⟨i, ⟨homOfLE inf_le_right⟩⟩,
169	      ⟨hx, ?_⟩⟩
170	    exact (leOfHom gi) hU'
171	  -- Per-slice presentations through the restricted-pullback bridge.
172	  haveI hslice : ∀ i,
173	      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F).over (g ⁻¹ᵁ q.X i)).IsQuasicoherent := fun i =>
174	    (presentationPullbackSliceOfOver g F (q.X i) (q.presentation i)).isQuasicoherent
175	  exact SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop
176	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F) (fun i => g ⁻¹ᵁ q.X i) hcov
177	
178	end AlgebraicGeometry

114	No spectral sequence is needed here: this is the *separated* case (`[IsSeparated f]`).

118	section HomologyComm
119	
120	variable {C D : Type*} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D]
121	  [CategoryWithHomology C] [CategoryWithHomology D]
122	
123	/-- **Complex-level upgrade of `ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso`.** An additive functor `F`
124	that preserves homology commutes with `HomologicalComplex.homology`. The degree-`i`
125	short complex of `(F.mapHomologicalComplex c).obj K` is *definitionally* `F` applied to
126	the degree-`i` short complex `K.sc i` of `K` (both have `Xⱼ = F.obj (K.Xⱼ)` and
127	`d = F.map (K.d)`), so this is exactly `ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso (K.sc i) F`. -/
128	noncomputable def mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
129	    [F.PreservesHomology] {ι : Type*} {c : ComplexShape ι} (K : HomologicalComplex C c) (i : ι) :
130	    ((F.mapHomologicalComplex c).obj K).homology i ≅ F.obj (K.homology i) :=
131	  ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso (K.sc i) F
132	
133	end HomologyComm

135	/-- **Flat base change has left-adjoint pullback**, hence `g^*` preserves finite
136	colimits (free: `g^* = pullback g` is a left adjoint). -/
137	instance pullback_preservesFiniteColimits (g : S' ⟶ S) :
138	    Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits (Scheme.Modules.pullback g) := inferInstance
139	
140	/-- **Flat implies `g^*` is left-exact.**  This is not yet proved; what follows records the
141	reduction.
142	
143	By `SheafOfModules.pullbackIso`, the pullback factors as
144	`g^* ≅ forget ⋙ (PresheafOfModules.pullback φ.hom ⋙ PresheafOfModules.sheafification)`.
145	Two of the three factors preserve finite limits *in Mathlib already*:
146	* `SheafOfModules.forget` — `SheafOfModules.forgetPreservesFiniteLimits` (it is a right
147	  adjoint to sheafification);
148	* `PresheafOfModules.sheafification` — the instance in
149	  `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Sheafification.lean` (sheafification is a
150	  left-exact reflector; needs `HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat`, which holds for the scheme
151	  site since `X.Modules` is abelian).
152	
153	So the *only* irreducible content is that the **presheaf-level** pullback
154	`PresheafOfModules.pullback φ.hom` preserves finite limits when `g` is flat. Mathlib
155	defines this presheaf pullback purely as `(pushforward φ).leftAdjoint` with **no
156	pointwise description**; mathematically it is the inverse image `g⁻¹` (exact) followed
157	by extension of scalars along the flat ring map (left-exact, cf.
158	`ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat`), but neither this factorisation
159	nor its left-exactness is available.  Assembling the argument via `pullbackIso`
160	additionally requires the `sheafification`/`HasSheafify` instances for the scheme site. -/
161	instance pullback_preservesFiniteLimits (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat g] :
162	    Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.Modules.pullback g) := sorry
163	
164	/-- **Flat implies `g^*` preserves homology**, derived from left-exactness together with
165	left-adjointness via `Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact`. -/
166	instance pullback_preservesHomology (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat g] :
167	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).PreservesHomology := inferInstance
168	
169	/-- **`g^*` commutes with Čech homology** (flat exactness, at the level of complexes).
170	A specialisation of `mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso` to `g^* = pullback g`, which is
171	additive and, for `g` flat, preserves homology. -/
172	noncomputable def pullback_mapHC_homologyIso (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat g]
173	    (K : CochainComplex S.Modules ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
174	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K).homology i
175	      ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (K.homology i) :=
176	  mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso (Scheme.Modules.pullback g) K i

178	/-! ## Additive functors and the alternating coface complex
179	
180	The relative Čech complex `CechComplex` is, by construction
181	(`relativeCechComplexOfNerve`), the alternating coface-map cochain complex of a
182	cosimplicial object.  The base change `cechComplex_baseChange_iso` must move the
183	degreewise pullback `g^*` *inside* this `alternatingCofaceMapComplex` construction.  The
184	following two declarations package exactly that move at the cosimplicial level, with no
185	reference to schemes: an additive functor `F` commutes with the alternating coface map
186	complex, naturally in the cosimplicial variable. -/

195	`objD`. -/
196	private theorem alternatingCofaceMapComplex_d
197	    (Y : CosimplicialObject C) (n : ℕ) :
198	    ((alternatingCofaceMapComplex C).obj Y).d n (n + 1)
199	      = AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD Y n := by

206	/-- **The kernel–pullback comparison map** `g'^*(ker q) ⟶ ker (g'^* q)`
207	(the abstract `CategoryTheory.Limits.kernelComparison` at the module pullback
208	functor; the pullback preserves zero morphisms, being a left adjoint —
209	`Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction` — between abelian categories).
210	It is characterised by `κ ≫ ker(g'^*q).ι = g'^*(ker q .ι)`
211	(`kernelComparison_comp_ι`).  `Scheme.Modules.pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial`
212	(blueprint `lem:relative_divisor_base_change`) proves it is an isomorphism
213	when the cokernel of `ker q ⟶ E` is flat over the base of a cartesian
214	square. -/
215	noncomputable def Modules.pullbackKernelComparison
216	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) :
217	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj (Limits.kernel q) ⟶
218	      Limits.kernel ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q) :=
219	  kernelComparison q (Scheme.Modules.pullback g')

223	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) :
224	    Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q ≫
225	        Limits.kernel.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q) =
226	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map (Limits.kernel.ι q) :=
227	  kernelComparison_comp_ι q (Scheme.Modules.pullback g')
228	
229	/-- **The kernel–pullback comparison is an epimorphism whenever `q` is an
230	epimorphism.**  This is the categorical (right-exact) half of the isomorphism
231	claim in `Scheme.Modules.pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial`: the module pullback
232	`g'^*` is a left adjoint
233	(`Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`), hence preserves cokernels, so
234	applied to the short exact sequence `0 → ker q → E → F → 0` (`q` epi, so `F` is
235	the cokernel of `ker q ↪ E`) it stays right exact: `g'^*(ker q) → g'^*E →
236	g'^*F → 0` is exact.  Exactness at `g'^*E` says precisely that the kernel lift
237	`g'^*(ker q) → ker (g'^* q)` — which is `pullbackKernelComparison g' q` — is an
238	epimorphism.  (The remaining monomorphism half is the genuine flat-base-change
239	content, requiring `F` flat over the base, and is handled in
240	`pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial`.) -/

242	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q] :
243	    Epi (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q) := by
244	  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (Scheme.Modules.pullback g') :=
245	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g').leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
246	  have hSG := (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.exact_kernel q).map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel
247	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g') ‹Epi q› inferInstance
248	  exact hSG.epi_kernelLift

250	/-- **Basis-local criterion for monomorphisms of `𝒪_X`-modules.**  If `B` is a basis of
251	opens of `X` and `φ : M ⟶ N` is injective on sections over every basic open `B i`, then
252	`φ` is a monomorphism.  Companion of the basis-local iso criterion
253	`Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_of_isBasis` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.FlatBaseChange`):
254	basis injectivity gives stalkwise injectivity
255	(`TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis`), hence the underlying morphism of
256	sheaves of abelian groups is a monomorphism (`TopCat.Presheaf.mono_of_stalk_mono`), and the
257	faithful forgetful functor `Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf` reflects it. -/
258	theorem Modules.mono_of_injective_app_of_isBasis {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
259	    {ι : Type*} {B : ι → X.Opens} (hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis (Set.range B))
260	    (φ : M ⟶ N) (h : ∀ i, Function.Injective (φ.app (B i))) : Mono φ := by
261	  have happ : ∀ U ∈ Set.range B,
262	      Function.Injective (((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ).app (Opposite.op U)) := by
263	    rintro U ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact h i
264	  have hstalk : ∀ x : X, Function.Injective
265	      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).map ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ)) :=
266	    fun x => TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis hB happ x
267	  let MS : TopCat.Sheaf Ab.{u} X := ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩
268	  let NS : TopCat.Sheaf Ab.{u} X := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩
269	  let fS : MS ⟶ NS := ⟨(Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ⟩

271	    (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr (hstalk x)

273	  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ) :=
274	    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.Hom.mono_iff_presheaf_mono _ _ fS).mp hmS
275	  exact (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).mono_of_mono_map ‹_›

277	/-- **The kernel–pullback comparison is an isomorphism as soon as `g'^*` keeps
278	the kernel inclusion `ker q ↪ E` monic.**  Combining the always-available
279	epimorphism half (`epi_pullbackKernelComparison`, `q` epi) with the
280	monomorphism half, `X'.Modules` being abelian (hence balanced) upgrades
281	`pullbackKernelComparison g' q` to an isomorphism: `κ` is monic because
282	`κ ≫ ker(g'^*q).ι = g'^*(ker q .ι)` (`pullbackKernelComparison_comp_ι`) is monic
283	(the hypothesis, with `ker(g'^*q).ι` monic), and epi + mono ⟹ iso.
284	
285	This isolates the *entire* remaining content of
286	`Scheme.Modules.pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial` into the single flat-base-change
287	fact `Mono (g'^*(ker q .ι))` — that the right-exact pullback preserves the
288	injection `ker q ↪ E` because the cokernel `F` is flat over the base
289	(Stacks 00HL, `Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_exact`, affine-locally through the
290	base-change section calculus). -/
291	lemma Modules.isIso_pullbackKernelComparison_of_mono
292	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q]
293	    (hmono : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map (Limits.kernel.ι q))) :
294	    IsIso (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q) := by
295	  haveI := Modules.epi_pullbackKernelComparison g' q
296	  haveI : Mono (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q ≫
297	      Limits.kernel.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q)) := by
298	    rw [Modules.pullbackKernelComparison_comp_ι]; exact hmono
299	  haveI : Mono (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q) :=
300	    mono_of_mono _ (Limits.kernel.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q))
301	  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi _

303	/-! ## §4. Shrinking a trivialising chart -/
304	
305	namespace LineBundle
306	
307	/-- **A trivialising chart restricts along any smaller open** (the Stacks
308	01HH chart chase of `IsLocallyTrivial.pullback`, specialised to the open
309	inclusion `V ≤ U`): if `M|_U ≅ 𝒪_U` and `V ≤ U`, then `M|_V ≅ 𝒪_V`.  The
310	witness is the `i1–i7` restriction/pullback chain along
311	`g := X.homOfLE hVU : V ⟶ U` — `g ≫ U.ι = V.ι`, so restriction to `V`
312	factors as pullback along `g` of the restriction to `U`, and the pullback of
313	the unit is the unit (`SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit`, an isomorphism
314	because `Opens.map g.base` is final). -/
315	lemma IsLocallyTrivial.trivialization_of_le {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules}
316	    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
317	    (t : M.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) :
318	    Nonempty (M.restrict V.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (V : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) := by
319	  set g : (V : Scheme) ⟶ (U : Scheme) := X.homOfLE hVU with hg_def
320	  have hgι : g ≫ U.ι = V.ι := X.homOfLE_ι hVU
321	  haveI : (TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g.base).Final :=
322	    CategoryTheory.final_of_representablyFlat _
323	  refine ⟨?_⟩
324	  -- 1: M.restrict V.ι ≅ (pullback V.ι).obj M
325	  let i1 := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι).app M
326	  -- 2: ≅ (pullback (g ≫ U.ι)).obj M  (using V.ι = g ≫ U.ι)
327	  let i2 := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hgι.symm).app M
328	  -- 3: ≅ (pullback g).obj ((pullback U.ι).obj M)
329	  let i3 := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g U.ι).symm).app M
330	  -- 4: ≅ (pullback g).obj (unit_U)  (restrict back and trivialise)
331	  let i4 := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapIso
332	    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).symm.app M ≪≫ t)
333	  -- 5: ≅ unit_V  (pullback of the unit is the unit; iso since `Opens.map
334	  -- g.base` is final)
335	  let i5 := asIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom)
336	  exact i1 ≪≫ i2 ≪≫ i3 ≪≫ i4 ≪≫ i5
337	
338	/-- **Chart shrinking**: a locally trivial module has a trivialising *affine*
339	chart inside any open neighbourhood of any point.  Combines the defining
340	chart of `IsLocallyTrivial` with an affine shrink
341	(`exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset`) and the restriction of the
342	trivialisation (`trivialization_of_le`). -/
343	lemma IsLocallyTrivial.exists_affine_trivializing_le
344	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules} (hM : IsLocallyTrivial M)
345	    {x : X} {W : X.Opens} (hxW : x ∈ W) :
346	    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ IsAffineOpen V ∧ V ≤ W ∧
347	      Nonempty (M.restrict V.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (V : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) := by
348	  obtain ⟨U, hxU, hUaff, ⟨t⟩⟩ := hM x
349	  obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hxV, hVle⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset

15	"iso ⟺ iso on every open" criterion (`Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app`) and the

17	this *joint* cover-conservativity statement.  It is the keystone of the open-immersion
18	Beck–Chevalley leaf of the flat-base-change development (Stacks 02KH): it lets one verify that the
19	base-change comparison morphism is an isomorphism by checking it on the members of an affine cover.
20	
21	The reverse (content) direction goes through the underlying presheaves of abelian groups: the
22	forgetful functor `Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X` reflects isomorphisms, presheaves of modules are
23	sheaves of abelian groups (`Scheme.Modules.isSheaf`), and isomorphy of a sheaf-of-`Ab` morphism is
24	detected on stalks (`TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_iff_stalkFunctor_map_iso`); the per-point reduction to a
25	cover member is exactly `Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso`.

32	/-- A morphism of sheaves of modules on a scheme is an isomorphism iff its restriction to every
33	member of an open cover is an isomorphism.  This is the joint cover-conservativity of the family of
34	restriction functors `{restrictFunctor (𝒰.f j)}`; project-local because Mathlib only packages the
35	single-open criterion `isIso_iff_isIso_app` and the per-leg stalk comparison `restrictStalkNatIso`,
36	not this assembled cover statement. -/
37	theorem isIso_iff_isIso_restrict
38	    {X : Scheme} {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) :
39	    IsIso φ ↔ ∀ j, IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (𝒰.f j)).map φ) := by
40	  constructor
41	  · -- (⟹) restriction functors preserve isomorphisms.
42	    intro h j
43	    haveI := h
44	    infer_instance
45	  · -- (⟸) the content direction.
46	    intro hj
47	    -- It suffices that the underlying presheaf morphism is an iso: `toPresheaf X` reflects isos.
48	    haveI key : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ) := by
49	      -- Present `M`, `N` as sheaves of abelian groups and `φ` as a morphism of `TopCat.Sheaf Ab`.
50	      set F : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X.carrier := ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ with hF
51	      set G : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X.carrier := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩ with hG
52	      set fS : F ⟶ G := ⟨(Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ⟩ with hfS_def
53	      -- It suffices that `fS` be an iso: `Sheaf.forget` sends it to `(toPresheaf X).map φ`.
54	      suffices hfS : IsIso fS by
55	        haveI : IsIso fS := hfS
56	        exact Functor.map_isIso (TopCat.Sheaf.forget Ab X.carrier) fS
57	      -- Detect isomorphy of the sheaf-of-`Ab` morphism on stalks.
58	      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_iff_stalkFunctor_map_iso]
59	      intro x
60	      change IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ))
61	      -- Choose a cover member through `x` and a preimage point `y`.
62	      set j := 𝒰.idx x with hj_def
63	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := 𝒰.covers x
64	      rw [← hy]
65	      -- The restricted morphism is an iso (hyp); push it through the functors to its `y`-stalk.
66	      haveI hrestr := hj j
67	      have hstalk : IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab y).map
68	          ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (𝒰.X j)).map
69	            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (𝒰.f j)).map φ))) :=
70	        Functor.map_isIso _ _
71	      -- `restrictStalkNatIso` conjugates the `y`-stalk of the restriction with `φ`'s `x`-stalk.
72	      exact (NatIso.isIso_map_iff (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (𝒰.f j) y) φ).mp hstalk
73	    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso φ (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X)
74

130	      = TopCat.Presheaf.germ (AlgebraicGeometry.moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf ⊤ x
131	          (by trivial) (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R N ⊤ (f.hom m))
132	  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply ⊤ x True.intro
133	    ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (tilde.map f)) (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R M ⊤ m)]
134	  congr 1
135	  simp only [Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf_map, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
136	    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app]
137	  rw [StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ_eq_const, StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ_eq_const]
138	  simp only [AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map, AlgebraicGeometry.SpecModulesToSheafFullyFaithful,
139	    CategoryTheory.NatTrans.comp_app, AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.modulesSpecToSheafIso,
140	    ModuleCat.hom_comp]
141	  erw [StructureSheaf.comapₗ_const (hb := le_of_eq PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_one.symm)]
142	  rfl

144	/-- **Reduction of `tildePreservesFiniteLimits` to the presheaf level.**  The forgetful functor
145	`Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf` from `𝒪_{Spec R}`-modules to presheaves of abelian groups is faithful,
146	preserves limits, and reflects isomorphisms; hence (since `(Spec R).Modules` has finite limits) it
147	reflects finite limits.  Therefore, to show `~` preserves finite limits it suffices to show the
148	composite `~ ⋙ toPresheaf` does.  This isolates the remaining obligation of
149	`lem:tilde_preserves_kernels` to a statement about the abelian-presheaf-valued composite, whose
150	stalks are computed by `tilde_stalkFunctor_map_toStalk`.  Project-local categorical glue (it refutes
151	the earlier-feared "no right-exact + mono ⟹ left-exact" obstruction: the reduction is purely
152	`preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves`). -/
153	theorem tildePreservesFiniteLimits_of_toPresheaf
154	    (H : PreservesFiniteLimits
155	      (tilde.functor R ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R)))) :
156	    PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R) :=
157	  haveI := H
158	  Limits.preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves (tilde.functor R)
159	    (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R)))

161	/-! ## Project-local Mathlib supplement — R-linear packaging of the Ab-stalk map -/
162	
163	/-- **Germ–scalar compatibility (`R`-linearity of the germ map).**  For `s` a section of `M^~`
164	over `U` and `r : R`, the germ at `x` of `(algebraMap R Γ(O_X,U) r) • s` equals `r •` the germ of
165	`s` (the `R`-action on the stalk being the localisation one through `tilde.toStalk R x`).  This is
166	the section-level half of "the `Ab`-stalk map of `~f` is `R`-linear".  Project-local because the
167	linear germ `StructureSheaf.germₗ` is not exported (no `public`); it is rebuilt here from the public
168	`PresheafOfModules.germ_smul` and `StructureSheaf.algebraMap_germ_apply`. -/
169	theorem tilde_germ_algebraMap_smul {M : ModuleCat R} (U : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
170	    (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) (hxU : x ∈ U) (r : R) (s : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M, U)) :
171	    (ConcreteCategory.hom
172	        ((AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf.germ U x hxU))
173	        ((algebraMap R Γ(Spec (.of R), U) r) • s)
174	      = r • (ConcreteCategory.hom
175	        ((AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf.germ U x hxU)) s := by
176	  erw [PresheafOfModules.germ_smul, StructureSheaf.algebraMap_germ_apply]
177	  rfl
178	
179	/-- **Sub-step (A): the `Ab`-stalk map `σ_x` is `R`-linear.**  The stalk-functor image
180	`σ_x := (stalkFunctor Ab x).map (toPresheaf.map (~f))` is a priori only an `Ab`-morphism between
181	the stalks; this packages it as the genuine `R`-linear map `M_𝔭 →ₗ[R] N_𝔭`.  Project-local: the
182	`ModuleCat R`-valued stalk functor for `SheafOfModules` is not exported (its building blocks
183	`stalkIsoₗ`/`toStalkₗ'` are private), so the linear structure is reconstructed here on the public
184	`Ab` stalk via germ-linearity. -/
185	noncomputable def stalkMapₗ {M N : ModuleCat R} (f : M ⟶ N) (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) :
186	    (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf.stalk x →ₗ[R]
187	      (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde N).presheaf.stalk x where
188	  toFun := (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor _ x).map
189	    ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map f))
190	  map_add' a b := map_add _ a b
191	  map_smul' r ζ := by
192	    dsimp only [RingHom.id_apply]
193	    obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf ζ
194	    rw [← tilde_germ_algebraMap_smul U x hxU r s]
195	    erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply U x hxU
196	        ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map f)),
197	      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply U x hxU
198	        ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map f))]
199	    rw [Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf_map, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app]
200	    simp only [Opposite.unop_op]
201	    erw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, tilde_germ_algebraMap_smul U x hxU r]
202	    rfl
203	
204	/-- **Identification of `σ_x` with the localised module map.**  The `R`-linear `Ab`-stalk map
205	`stalkMapₗ f x` is exactly the localisation `M_𝔭 →ₗ[R] N_𝔭` of `f`, i.e.
206	`IsLocalizedModule.map _ (toStalk M x) (toStalk N x) f`.  Both are `R`-linear and agree on the image
207	of the localisation map `tilde.toStalk M x` (by `tilde_stalkFunctor_map_toStalk`), so they coincide
208	by `IsLocalizedModule.ext`.  Project-local: it packages the otherwise opaque germ-induced stalk map
209	as the concrete localised map, whose flatness-injectivity is `tilde_toStalk_map_injective`. -/
210	theorem stalkMapₗ_eq {M N : ModuleCat R} (f : M ⟶ N) (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) :
211	    stalkMapₗ f x = IsLocalizedModule.map x.asIdeal.primeCompl
212	      (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk M x).hom (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk N x).hom
213	      f.hom := by
214	  apply IsLocalizedModule.ext x.asIdeal.primeCompl (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk M x).hom
215	    (fun s => IsLocalizedModule.map_units (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk N x).hom s)
216	  ext m
217	  change stalkMapₗ f x ((AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk M x).hom m) = _
218	  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, IsLocalizedModule.map_apply]
219	  exact tilde_stalkFunctor_map_toStalk f x m
220	
221	/-- **Stalkwise injectivity of `~f` for a monomorphism `f`.**  For an injective `R`-module map
222	`f`, the `R`-linear `Ab`-stalk map `σ_x = stalkMapₗ f x` of `~f` is injective at every point `x`.
223	This is the stalkwise-flatness contribution to mono-preservation of `~`, now stated on the genuine
224	linear stalk map: it combines the identification `stalkMapₗ_eq` with the localisation injectivity
225	`tilde_toStalk_map_injective`.  Project-local stepping stone toward `tildePreservesFiniteLimits`. -/
226	theorem stalkMapₗ_injective {M N : ModuleCat R} (f : M ⟶ N) (hf : Function.Injective f.hom)
227	    (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) : Function.Injective (stalkMapₗ f x) := by
228	  rw [stalkMapₗ_eq]
229	  exact tilde_toStalk_map_injective f hf x
230	
231	end AlgebraicGeometry

10	/-!
11	## Project-local Mathlib supplement — cover-localization iso criterion for `Scheme.Modules`
12	
13	A morphism `φ : M ⟶ N` of sheaves of modules on a scheme `X` is an isomorphism iff its
14	restriction to each member of an open cover `𝒰` is an isomorphism.  Mathlib has the
15	"iso ⟺ iso on every open" criterion (`Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app`) and the
16	"restrict-to-open-immersion vs. stalk" comparison (`Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso`), but not
17	this *joint* cover-conservativity statement.  It is the keystone of the open-immersion
18	Beck–Chevalley leaf of the flat-base-change development (Stacks 02KH): it lets one verify that the
19	base-change comparison morphism is an isomorphism by checking it on the members of an affine cover.
20	
21	The reverse (content) direction goes through the underlying presheaves of abelian groups: the
22	forgetful functor `Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X` reflects isomorphisms, presheaves of modules are
23	sheaves of abelian groups (`Scheme.Modules.isSheaf`), and isomorphy of a sheaf-of-`Ab` morphism is
24	detected on stalks (`TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_iff_stalkFunctor_map_iso`); the per-point reduction to a
25	cover member is exactly `Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso`.
26	-/
27	
28	open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory
29	
30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom
31	
32	/-- A morphism of sheaves of modules on a scheme is an isomorphism iff its restriction to every
33	member of an open cover is an isomorphism.  This is the joint cover-conservativity of the family of
34	restriction functors `{restrictFunctor (𝒰.f j)}`; project-local because Mathlib only packages the
35	single-open criterion `isIso_iff_isIso_app` and the per-leg stalk comparison `restrictStalkNatIso`,
36	not this assembled cover statement. -/
37	theorem isIso_iff_isIso_restrict
38	    {X : Scheme} {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) :
39	    IsIso φ ↔ ∀ j, IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (𝒰.f j)).map φ) := by
40	  constructor
41	  · -- (⟹) restriction functors preserve isomorphisms.
42	    intro h j
43	    haveI := h
44	    infer_instance
45	  · -- (⟸) the content direction.
46	    intro hj
47	    -- It suffices that the underlying presheaf morphism is an iso: `toPresheaf X` reflects isos.
48	    haveI key : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ) := by
49	      -- Present `M`, `N` as sheaves of abelian groups and `φ` as a morphism of `TopCat.Sheaf Ab`.
50	      set F : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X.carrier := ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ with hF
51	      set G : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X.carrier := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩ with hG
52	      set fS : F ⟶ G := ⟨(Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ⟩ with hfS_def
53	      -- It suffices that `fS` be an iso: `Sheaf.forget` sends it to `(toPresheaf X).map φ`.
54	      suffices hfS : IsIso fS by
55	        haveI : IsIso fS := hfS
56	        exact Functor.map_isIso (TopCat.Sheaf.forget Ab X.carrier) fS
57	      -- Detect isomorphy of the sheaf-of-`Ab` morphism on stalks.
58	      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_iff_stalkFunctor_map_iso]
59	      intro x
60	      change IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ))
61	      -- Choose a cover member through `x` and a preimage point `y`.
62	      set j := 𝒰.idx x with hj_def
63	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := 𝒰.covers x
64	      rw [← hy]
65	      -- The restricted morphism is an iso (hyp); push it through the functors to its `y`-stalk.
66	      haveI hrestr := hj j
67	      have hstalk : IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab y).map
68	          ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (𝒰.X j)).map
69	            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (𝒰.f j)).map φ))) :=
70	        Functor.map_isIso _ _
71	      -- `restrictStalkNatIso` conjugates the `y`-stalk of the restriction with `φ`'s `x`-stalk.
72	      exact (NatIso.isIso_map_iff (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (𝒰.f j) y) φ).mp hstalk
73	    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso φ (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X)
74	
75	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom

12:/-!
13:# Left exactness of functors between preadditive categories
14:
15:We show that a functor is left exact in the sense that it preserves finite limits, if it
16:preserves kernels. The dual result holds for right exact functors and cokernels.
17:
18:## Main results
19:
20:* We first derive preservation of binary product in the lemma
21:  `preservesBinaryProductsOfPreservesKernels`,
22:* then show the preservation of equalizers in `preservesEqualizerOfPreservesKernels`,
23:* and then derive the preservation of all finite limits with the usual construction.
24:
25:-/
26:
27:@[expose] public section
28:
29:
30:universe v₁ v₂ u₁ u₂
31:
32:noncomputable section
33:
34:open CategoryTheory
35:
36:open CategoryTheory.Limits
37:
38:open CategoryTheory.Preadditive

40:namespace CategoryTheory

42:namespace Functor

44:variable {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Preadditive C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
45:  [Preadditive D] (F : C ⥤ D) [PreservesZeroMorphisms F]
46:
47:section FiniteLimits
48:
49:/-- A functor between preadditive categories which preserves kernels preserves that an
50:arbitrary binary fan is a limit.
=== full relevant
1:  haveI := additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts F
2:  constructor; intro c i
3:  let c' := isLimitKernelForkOfFork (i.ofIsoLimit (Fork.isoForkOfι c))
4:  dsimp only [kernelForkOfFork_ofι] at c'
5:  let iFc := isLimitForkMapOfIsLimit' F _ c'
6:  constructor
7:  apply IsLimit.ofIsoLimit _ ((Cone.functoriality _ F).mapIso (Fork.isoForkOfι c).symm)
8:  apply (isLimitMapConeForkEquiv F (Fork.condition c)).invFun
9:  let p : parallelPair (F.map (f - g)) 0 ≅ parallelPair (F.map f - F.map g) 0 :=
10:    parallelPair.eqOfHomEq F.map_sub rfl
11:  exact
12:    IsLimit.ofIsoLimit
13:      (isLimitForkOfKernelFork ((IsLimit.postcomposeHomEquiv p _).symm iFc))
14:      (Fork.ext (Iso.refl _) (by simp [p]))

16:/-- A functor between preadditive categories preserves all equalizers if it preserves all kernels.
17:-/
18:lemma preservesEqualizers_of_preservesKernels
19:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
20:    PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair F where
21:  preservesLimit {K} := by
22:    letI := preservesEqualizer_of_preservesKernels F (K.map WalkingParallelPairHom.left)
23:        (K.map WalkingParallelPairHom.right)
24:    apply preservesLimit_of_iso_diagram F (diagramIsoParallelPair K).symm

27:-/
28:lemma preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesKernels [HasFiniteProducts C] [HasEqualizers C]
29:    [HasZeroObject C] [HasZeroObject D] [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
30:    PreservesFiniteLimits F :=
31:  have := preservesEqualizers_of_preservesKernels F
32:  have := preservesTerminalObject_of_preservesZeroMorphisms F
33:  have := preservesLimitsOfShape_pempty_of_preservesTerminal F
34:  have : PreservesFiniteProducts F := .of_preserves_binary_and_terminal F
35:  preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesEqualizers_and_finiteProducts F

41:/-- A functor between preadditive categories which preserves cokernels preserves finite coproducts.
42:-/
43:def isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanOfPreservesCokernels {X Y Z : C} (ι₁ : X ⟶ Z) (ι₂ : Y ⟶ Z)
44:    [PreservesColimit (parallelPair ι₂ 0) F] (i : IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk ι₁ ι₂)) :
45:    IsColimit (F.mapCocone (BinaryCofan.mk ι₁ ι₂)) := by
46:  let bc := BinaryBicone.ofColimitCocone i

50:    (isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanEquiv F ι₁ ι₂).invFun
51:      (BinaryBicone.isBilimitOfCokernelFst (F.mapBinaryBicone bc)
52:          (isColimitMapCoconeCoforkEquiv' F bc.inr_fst (isColimitOfPreserves F hf))).isColimit

54:/-- A cokernel-preserving functor between preadditive categories preserves any pair being
55:a colimit. -/
56:lemma preservesCoproduct_of_preservesCokernels
57:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] {X Y : C} :
58:    PreservesColimit (pair X Y) F where
59:  preserves {c} hc :=
60:    ⟨IsColimit.ofIsoColimit
61:      (isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanOfPreservesCokernels F _ _
62:        (IsColimit.ofIsoColimit hc (isoBinaryCofanMk c)))

67:/-- A cokernel-preserving functor between preadditive categories preserves binary coproducts. -/
68:lemma preservesBinaryCoproducts_of_preservesCokernels
69:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
70:    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete WalkingPair) F where
71:  preservesColimit := preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram F (diagramIsoPair _).symm

73:attribute [local instance] preservesBinaryCoproducts_of_preservesCokernels

75:variable [HasBinaryBiproducts C]

77:set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
78:/-- A functor between preadditive categories preserves the coequalizer of two
79:morphisms if it preserves all cokernels. -/
80:lemma preservesCoequalizer_of_preservesCokernels
81:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) :
82:    PreservesColimit (parallelPair f g) F := by
83:  letI := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryCoproducts F
84:  haveI := additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts F
85:  constructor
86:  intro c i
87:  let c' := isColimitCokernelCoforkOfCofork (i.ofIsoColimit (Cofork.isoCoforkOfπ c))
88:  dsimp only [cokernelCoforkOfCofork_ofπ] at c'
89:  let iFc := isColimitCoforkMapOfIsColimit' F _ c'
90:  constructor
91:  apply
92:    IsColimit.ofIsoColimit _ ((Cocone.functoriality _ F).mapIso (Cofork.isoCoforkOfπ c).symm)
93:  apply (isColimitMapCoconeCoforkEquiv F (Cofork.condition c)).invFun
94:  let p : parallelPair (F.map (f - g)) 0 ≅ parallelPair (F.map f - F.map g) 0 :=
95:    parallelPair.ext (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp)
96:  exact
97:    IsColimit.ofIsoColimit
98:      (isColimitCoforkOfCokernelCofork ((IsColimit.precomposeHomEquiv p.symm _).symm iFc))
99:      (Cofork.ext (Iso.refl _) (by simp [p]))
100:
101:/-- A functor between preadditive categories preserves all coequalizers if it preserves all kernels.
102:-/
103:lemma preservesCoequalizers_of_preservesCokernels
104:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
105:    PreservesColimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair F where
106:  preservesColimit {K} := by
107:    letI := preservesCoequalizer_of_preservesCokernels F (K.map Limits.WalkingParallelPairHom.left)
108:        (K.map Limits.WalkingParallelPairHom.right)
109:    apply preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram F (diagramIsoParallelPair K).symm
110:
111:/-- A functor between preadditive categories which preserves kernels preserves all finite limits.
112:-/
113:lemma preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesCokernels [HasFiniteCoproducts C] [HasCoequalizers C]
114:    [HasZeroObject C] [HasZeroObject D]
115:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
116:  letI := preservesCoequalizers_of_preservesCokernels F
117:  letI := preservesInitialObject_of_preservesZeroMorphisms F
118:  letI := preservesColimitsOfShape_pempty_of_preservesInitial F
119:  letI : PreservesFiniteCoproducts F :=
120:    ⟨fun _ ↦ PreservesFiniteCoproducts.of_preserves_binary_and_initial F _⟩
121:  exact preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesCoequalizers_and_finiteCoproducts F
122:
123:end FiniteColimits
124:
125:end Functor

    13	
    14	In this file, it is shown that under suitable assumptions,
    15	limits exist in the category `SheafOfModules R`.

    26	open CategoryTheory Category Limits

    28	variable {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    29	  {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    30	
    31	namespace PresheafOfModules
    32	
    33	variable {R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}}
    34	  {F : D ⥤ PresheafOfModules.{v} R}

    36	  {c : Cone F}

12	
13	Project-local supplement feeding `AlgebraicGeometry.qcoh_kernel_qcoh`.
14	
15	For `X = Spec R`, the tilde functor `~ : ModuleCat R ⥤ (Spec R).Modules`,
16	`M ↦ M^~`, is exact.  The named target of this file is
17	`AlgebraicGeometry.tildePreservesFiniteLimits : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R)`
18	(the *left*-exactness / kernel-preservation half).
19	
20	## What is delivered (axiom-clean)
21	
22	* `tilde_preservesFiniteColimits` — the *right*-exactness half: `~` is a left adjoint
23	  (`AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.adjunction`), hence preserves all colimits, in particular finite
24	  colimits.  This is one of the two halves of exactness.
25	* `tilde_toStalk_map_injective` — the *flatness core* in the only publicly-accessible form:
26	  for an injective `R`-module map `f : M ⟶ N`, the localised stalk map
27	  `M_𝔭 →ₗ[R] N_𝔭` (built from Mathlib's `IsLocalizedModule (tilde.toStalk · x)` instances) is
28	  injective.  This is the algebraic content that "localisation `R → R_𝔭` is flat" contributes
29	  to mono-preservation.
30	
31	## What is delivered (axiom-clean), continued
32	
33	* `tilde_stalkFunctor_map_toStalk` — the **germ-naturality** transport identity (the crux flagged
34	  by the planner).  For `f : M ⟶ N` and a point `x ↔ 𝔭`, the `Ab`-valued stalk map of `~f`
35	  (computed through the faithful, limit-preserving `Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf`) intertwines the two
36	  localisation maps `tilde.toStalk`: `toStalk M x ≫ (Ab-stalk map) = f ≫ toStalk N x`.  This
37	  identifies the otherwise opaque `Ab`-germ-induced stalk map with the localised module map of `f`
38	  on the image of `toStalk`.  Proven on the public `Ab`-stalk path (`stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply` +
39	  the `⊤`-section naturality `StructureSheaf.comapₗ_const`), avoiding the module-private handles.
40	* `tildePreservesFiniteLimits_of_toPresheaf` — the **categorical reduction**: since
41	  `Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf` reflects finite limits (faithful + preserves limits + reflects isos,
42	  and `(Spec R).Modules` has finite limits), `~` preserves finite limits as soon as the composite
43	  `~ ⋙ toPresheaf` does.  This is `Limits.preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves`.

48	**categorical-glue obstruction is FALSE** — `tildePreservesFiniteLimits_of_toPresheaf` (above)

95	    Function.Injective (IsLocalizedModule.map x.asIdeal.primeCompl
96	      (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk M x).hom (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk N x).hom f.hom) :=

106	    (H : ∀ {M N : ModuleCat R} (f : M ⟶ N),
107	      PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) (tilde.functor R)) :

124	        ((tilde.toStalk M x).hom m)

127	        ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (tilde.map f))
128	        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (AlgebraicGeometry.moduleStructurePresheaf R M).presheaf ⊤ x

133	    ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (tilde.map f)) (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R M ⊤ m)]

135	  simp only [Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf_map, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
136	    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app]
137	  rw [StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ_eq_const, StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ_eq_const]

163	/-- **Germ–scalar compatibility (`R`-linearity of the germ map).**  For `s` a section of `M^~`
164	over `U` and `r : R`, the germ at `x` of `(algebraMap R Γ(O_X,U) r) • s` equals `r •` the germ of

169	theorem tilde_germ_algebraMap_smul {M : ModuleCat R} (U : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
170	    (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) (hxU : x ∈ U) (r : R) (s : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M, U)) :
171	    (ConcreteCategory.hom
172	        ((AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf.germ U x hxU))
173	        ((algebraMap R Γ(Spec (.of R), U) r) • s)
174	      = r • (ConcreteCategory.hom
175	        ((AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf.germ U x hxU)) s := by
176	  erw [PresheafOfModules.germ_smul, StructureSheaf.algebraMap_germ_apply]

186	    (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf.stalk x →ₗ[R]
187	      (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde N).presheaf.stalk x where
188	  toFun := (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor _ x).map
189	    ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map f))
190	  map_add' a b := map_add _ a b
191	  map_smul' r ζ := by
192	    dsimp only [RingHom.id_apply]
193	    obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde M).presheaf ζ
194	    rw [← tilde_germ_algebraMap_smul U x hxU r s]
195	    erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply U x hxU
196	        ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map f)),
197	      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply U x hxU
198	        ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf (Spec (.of R))).map (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map f))]
199	    rw [Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf_map, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app]
200	    simp only [Opposite.unop_op]
201	    erw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, tilde_germ_algebraMap_smul U x hxU r]
202	    rfl

212	      (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk M x).hom (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toStalk N x).hom

108:For an additive functor `F : C ⥤ D` between abelian categories, the following are equivalent:

116:lemma preservesFiniteLimits_tfae : List.TFAE
117:    [
118:      ∀ (S : ShortComplex C), S.ShortExact → (S.map F).Exact ∧ Mono (F.map S.f),
119:      ∀ (S : ShortComplex C), S.Exact ∧ Mono S.f → (S.map F).Exact ∧ Mono (F.map S.f),
120:      ∀ ⦃X Y : C⦄ (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) F,
121:      PreservesFiniteLimits F
122:    ] := by
123:  tfae_have 1 → 2
124:  | hF, S, ⟨hS, hf⟩ => by
125:    have := preservesMonomorphisms_of_preserves_shortExact_left F hF
126:    refine ⟨?_, inferInstance⟩
127:    let T := ShortComplex.mk S.f (Abelian.coimage.π S.g) (Abelian.comp_coimage_π_eq_zero S.zero)
128:    let φ : T.map F ⟶ S.map F :=
129:      { τ₁ := 𝟙 _
130:        τ₂ := 𝟙 _
131:        τ₃ := F.map <| Abelian.factorThruCoimage S.g
132:        comm₂₃ := show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map _ = F.map (cokernel.π _) ≫ _ by
133:          rw [Category.id_comp, ← F.map_comp, cokernel.π_desc] }
134:    exact (exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono φ).1 (hF T ⟨(S.exact_iff_exact_coimage_π).1 hS⟩).1
135:  tfae_have 2 → 3

137:    refine preservesLimit_of_preserves_limit_cone (kernelIsKernel f) ?_
138:    apply (KernelFork.isLimitMapConeEquiv _ F).2

12:/-!
13:# Left exactness of functors between preadditive categories
14:
15:We show that a functor is left exact in the sense that it preserves finite limits, if it
16:preserves kernels. The dual result holds for right exact functors and cokernels.
17:
18:## Main results
19:
20:* We first derive preservation of binary product in the lemma
21:  `preservesBinaryProductsOfPreservesKernels`,
22:* then show the preservation of equalizers in `preservesEqualizerOfPreservesKernels`,
23:* and then derive the preservation of all finite limits with the usual construction.
24:
25:-/

50:arbitrary binary fan is a limit.

43:def isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanOfPreservesCokernels {X Y Z : C} (ι₁ : X ⟶ Z) (ι₂ : Y ⟶ Z)
44:    [PreservesColimit (parallelPair ι₂ 0) F] (i : IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk ι₁ ι₂)) :
45:    IsColimit (F.mapCocone (BinaryCofan.mk ι₁ ι₂)) := by

48:  let hf : IsColimit bc.inrCokernelCofork := BinaryBicone.isColimitInrCokernelCofork i
49:  exact
50:    (isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanEquiv F ι₁ ι₂).invFun
51:      (BinaryBicone.isBilimitOfCokernelFst (F.mapBinaryBicone bc)
52:          (isColimitMapCoconeCoforkEquiv' F bc.inr_fst (isColimitOfPreserves F hf))).isColimit

55:a colimit. -/

58:    PreservesColimit (pair X Y) F where

61:      (isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanOfPreservesCokernels F _ _

69:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
70:    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete WalkingPair) F where
71:  preservesColimit := preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram F (diagramIsoPair _).symm

73:attribute [local instance] preservesBinaryCoproducts_of_preservesCokernels

78:/-- A functor between preadditive categories preserves the coequalizer of two
79:morphisms if it preserves all cokernels. -/
80:lemma preservesCoequalizer_of_preservesCokernels
81:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) :
82:    PreservesColimit (parallelPair f g) F := by
83:  letI := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryCoproducts F
84:  haveI := additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts F
85:  constructor
86:  intro c i
87:  let c' := isColimitCokernelCoforkOfCofork (i.ofIsoColimit (Cofork.isoCoforkOfπ c))
88:  dsimp only [cokernelCoforkOfCofork_ofπ] at c'
89:  let iFc := isColimitCoforkMapOfIsColimit' F _ c'
90:  constructor
91:  apply
92:    IsColimit.ofIsoColimit _ ((Cocone.functoriality _ F).mapIso (Cofork.isoCoforkOfπ c).symm)
93:  apply (isColimitMapCoconeCoforkEquiv F (Cofork.condition c)).invFun
94:  let p : parallelPair (F.map (f - g)) 0 ≅ parallelPair (F.map f - F.map g) 0 :=
95:    parallelPair.ext (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp)
96:  exact
97:    IsColimit.ofIsoColimit
98:      (isColimitCoforkOfCokernelCofork ((IsColimit.precomposeHomEquiv p.symm _).symm iFc))
99:      (Cofork.ext (Iso.refl _) (by simp [p]))
100:
101:/-- A functor between preadditive categories preserves all coequalizers if it preserves all kernels.
102:-/
103:lemma preservesCoequalizers_of_preservesCokernels
104:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
105:    PreservesColimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair F where
106:  preservesColimit {K} := by
107:    letI := preservesCoequalizer_of_preservesCokernels F (K.map Limits.WalkingParallelPairHom.left)
108:        (K.map Limits.WalkingParallelPairHom.right)
109:    apply preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram F (diagramIsoParallelPair K).symm
110:
111:/-- A functor between preadditive categories which preserves kernels preserves all finite limits.
112:-/
113:lemma preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesCokernels [HasFiniteCoproducts C] [HasCoequalizers C]
114:    [HasZeroObject C] [HasZeroObject D]
115:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
116:  letI := preservesCoequalizers_of_preservesCokernels F
117:  letI := preservesInitialObject_of_preservesZeroMorphisms F
118:  letI := preservesColimitsOfShape_pempty_of_preservesInitial F
119:  letI : PreservesFiniteCoproducts F :=
120:    ⟨fun _ ↦ PreservesFiniteCoproducts.of_preserves_binary_and_initial F _⟩
121:  exact preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesCoequalizers_and_finiteCoproducts F
122:
123:end FiniteColimits

125:end Functor

215:  `0 ⟶ F(A) ⟶ F(B) ⟶ F(C) ⟶ 0` is exact.

220:lemma exact_tfae : List.TFAE
221:    [
222:      ∀ (S : ShortComplex C), S.ShortExact → (S.map F).ShortExact,
223:      ∀ (S : ShortComplex C), S.Exact → (S.map F).Exact,

226:    ] := by

8	/-!
9	# Pullback preserves quasi-coherence (Stacks 01BG, general morphism)
10	
11	For an arbitrary morphism of schemes `g : Y ⟶ X` and a quasi-coherent
12	`F : X.Modules`, the module pullback `g^* F = (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F`
13	is quasi-coherent (`pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom`).  This generalizes the
14	open-immersion case `isQuasicoherent_pullback_opens` (`CechTermAcyclic.lean`);
15	the previously-documented obstruction — `SheafOfModules.Presentation.map` only
16	transports a *global* presentation while quasi-coherence is *local* — is resolved
17	by localizing the pullback itself: over each member `U` of the quasi-coherence
18	cover of `X`, the restriction of `g^* F` to the preimage `W = g⁻¹(U)` is the
19	pullback of `F|_U` along the restricted morphism `g.resLE U W : W ⟶ U`
20	(the pullback pseudofunctor square `resLE_comp_ι`), and the *global* presentation
21	of `F|_U` transports along that restricted pullback.
22	
23	Two supporting facts are proved on the way:
24	
25	* `opensMap_final`: for any continuous map `φ`, the preimage functor
26	  `Opens.map φ` on opens is `Final` — the costructured comma poset
27	  `{U // d ≤ φ⁻¹(U)}` is nonempty (`⊤`) and `⊔`-directed, hence filtered.
28	* `pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso_hom`: consequently Mathlib's unit comparison
29	  `pullbackObjUnitToUnit` is an isomorphism for the module pullback along *any*
30	  scheme morphism, i.e. `g^* 𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y` (`pullbackUnitIso`).
31	
32	These feed the flat-base-change RHS tilde leaf
33	`pushPullObj_coverInter_baseChanged_pushforward_iso_tilde`
34	(`CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean`), which needs quasi-coherence of the
35	base-changed module `g'^* F` to apply the altitude-2 bridge
36	`pushPullObj_pushforward_iso_tilde` on the base-changed side.
37	-/

160	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F).IsQuasicoherent := by

162	  -- The preimages of the quasi-coherence cover of `X` cover `Y`.

12:/-!
13:# Left exactness of functors between preadditive categories
14:
15:We show that a functor is left exact in the sense that it preserves finite limits, if it
16:preserves kernels. The dual result holds for right exact functors and cokernels.
17:
18:## Main results
19:
20:* We first derive preservation of binary product in the lemma
21:  `preservesBinaryProductsOfPreservesKernels`,
22:* then show the preservation of equalizers in `preservesEqualizerOfPreservesKernels`,
23:* and then derive the preservation of all finite limits with the usual construction.
24:
25:-/
26:
27:@[expose] public section
28:
29:
30:universe v₁ v₂ u₁ u₂
31:
32:noncomputable section
33:
34:open CategoryTheory
35:

37:

41:
42:namespace Functor
43:
44:variable {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Preadditive C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
45:  [Preadditive D] (F : C ⥤ D) [PreservesZeroMorphisms F]

47:section FiniteLimits
48:
49:/-- A functor between preadditive categories which preserves kernels preserves that an
50:arbitrary binary fan is a limit.
=== full relevant
1:  haveI := additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts F
2:  constructor; intro c i
3:  let c' := isLimitKernelForkOfFork (i.ofIsoLimit (Fork.isoForkOfι c))
4:  dsimp only [kernelForkOfFork_ofι] at c'
5:  let iFc := isLimitForkMapOfIsLimit' F _ c'
6:  constructor
7:  apply IsLimit.ofIsoLimit _ ((Cone.functoriality _ F).mapIso (Fork.isoForkOfι c).symm)
8:  apply (isLimitMapConeForkEquiv F (Fork.condition c)).invFun
9:  let p : parallelPair (F.map (f - g)) 0 ≅ parallelPair (F.map f - F.map g) 0 :=
10:    parallelPair.eqOfHomEq F.map_sub rfl
11:  exact
12:    IsLimit.ofIsoLimit
13:      (isLimitForkOfKernelFork ((IsLimit.postcomposeHomEquiv p _).symm iFc))
14:      (Fork.ext (Iso.refl _) (by simp [p]))

16:/-- A functor between preadditive categories preserves all equalizers if it preserves all kernels.
17:-/
18:lemma preservesEqualizers_of_preservesKernels
19:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
20:    PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair F where
21:  preservesLimit {K} := by
22:    letI := preservesEqualizer_of_preservesKernels F (K.map WalkingParallelPairHom.left)
23:        (K.map WalkingParallelPairHom.right)
24:    apply preservesLimit_of_iso_diagram F (diagramIsoParallelPair K).symm

26:/-- A functor between preadditive categories which preserves kernels preserves all finite limits.
27:-/
28:lemma preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesKernels [HasFiniteProducts C] [HasEqualizers C]
29:    [HasZeroObject C] [HasZeroObject D] [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) F] :
30:    PreservesFiniteLimits F :=
31:  have := preservesEqualizers_of_preservesKernels F
32:  have := preservesTerminalObject_of_preservesZeroMorphisms F
33:  have := preservesLimitsOfShape_pempty_of_preservesTerminal F
34:  have : PreservesFiniteProducts F := .of_preserves_binary_and_terminal F
35:  preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesEqualizers_and_finiteProducts F
36:

41:/-- A functor between preadditive categories which preserves cokernels preserves finite coproducts.
42:-/
43:def isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanOfPreservesCokernels {X Y Z : C} (ι₁ : X ⟶ Z) (ι₂ : Y ⟶ Z)
44:    [PreservesColimit (parallelPair ι₂ 0) F] (i : IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk ι₁ ι₂)) :
45:    IsColimit (F.mapCocone (BinaryCofan.mk ι₁ ι₂)) := by
46:  let bc := BinaryBicone.ofColimitCocone i
47:  let presf : PreservesColimit (parallelPair bc.inr 0) F := by simpa
48:  let hf : IsColimit bc.inrCokernelCofork := BinaryBicone.isColimitInrCokernelCofork i
49:  exact
50:    (isColimitMapCoconeBinaryCofanEquiv F ι₁ ι₂).invFun
51:      (BinaryBicone.isBilimitOfCokernelFst (F.mapBinaryBicone bc)
52:          (isColimitMapCoconeCoforkEquiv' F bc.inr_fst (isColimitOfPreserves F hf))).isColimit
53:
54:/-- A cokernel-preserving functor between preadditive categories preserves any pair being
55:a colimit. -/
56:lemma preservesCoproduct_of_preservesCokernels
57:    [∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) F] {X Y : C} :
58:    PreservesColimit (pair X Y) F where
59:  preserves {c} hc :=
60:    ⟨IsColimit.ofIsoColimit

152	    [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C]
153	    [Module R A] [Module R B] [Module R C]
154	    {f : A →ₗ[R] B} {g : B →ₗ[R] C}
155	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfg : Function.Exact f g)
156	    (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hC : Module.Flat R C)
157	    (N : Type*) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] :
158	    Function.Injective (f.rTensor N) := by

160	  exact Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_exact_aux
161	    (K := LinearMap.ker (Finsupp.linearCombination R (_root_.id : N → N)))
162	    (F₀ := (N →₀ R))

164	    (Finsupp.linearCombination R (_root_.id : N → N))

167	    ((Finsupp.linearCombination R (_root_.id : N → N)).exact_subtype_ker_map)
168	    (Finsupp.linearCombination_id_surjective R N)

170	/-- **Stacks 00HL, left-tensor form**: if `f : A → B` is injective, `g : B → C` is
171	surjective, `(f, g)` is exact and `C` is flat, then `𝟙_N ⊗ f : N ⊗ A → N ⊗ B` is
172	injective for every `N`.  Conjugate of `Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_exact` by the
173	tensor commutativity isomorphism (`LinearMap.comm_comp_rTensor_comp_comm_eq`): the
174	left-tensored map factors as `comm ∘ (f.rTensor N) ∘ comm`, a composite of the injective
175	`f.rTensor N` with the two commutativity equivalences. -/
176	theorem Module.Flat.lTensor_injective_of_exact
177	    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {A B C : Type*}
178	    [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C]

195	/-! ## §2. The unit module is quasi-coherent -/
196	
197	/-- **The unit module `𝒪_X` is quasi-coherent** (instance).  Witness: the
198	canonical one-generator/no-relation presentation
199	`LineBundle.unitPresentation` of `Picard/LineBundleCoherence.lean`. -/
200	instance Modules.unit_isQuasicoherent (X : Scheme.{u}) :
201	    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).IsQuasicoherent :=
202	  (LineBundle.unitPresentation (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).isQuasicoherent

204	/-! ## §3. The kernel–pullback comparison map -/
205	
206	/-- **The kernel–pullback comparison map** `g'^*(ker q) ⟶ ker (g'^* q)`
207	(the abstract `CategoryTheory.Limits.kernelComparison` at the module pullback
208	functor; the pullback preserves zero morphisms, being a left adjoint —
209	`Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction` — between abelian categories).
210	It is characterised by `κ ≫ ker(g'^*q).ι = g'^*(ker q .ι)`
211	(`kernelComparison_comp_ι`).  `Scheme.Modules.pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial`
212	(blueprint `lem:relative_divisor_base_change`) proves it is an isomorphism
213	when the cokernel of `ker q ⟶ E` is flat over the base of a cartesian
214	square. -/
215	noncomputable def Modules.pullbackKernelComparison
216	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) :
217	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj (Limits.kernel q) ⟶
218	      Limits.kernel ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q) :=
219	  kernelComparison q (Scheme.Modules.pullback g')
220	
221	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
222	lemma Modules.pullbackKernelComparison_comp_ι
223	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) :
224	    Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q ≫
225	        Limits.kernel.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q) =
226	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map (Limits.kernel.ι q) :=
227	  kernelComparison_comp_ι q (Scheme.Modules.pullback g')
228	
229	/-- **The kernel–pullback comparison is an epimorphism whenever `q` is an
230	epimorphism.**  This is the categorical (right-exact) half of the isomorphism
231	claim in `Scheme.Modules.pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial`: the module pullback
232	`g'^*` is a left adjoint
233	(`Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`), hence preserves cokernels, so
234	applied to the short exact sequence `0 → ker q → E → F → 0` (`q` epi, so `F` is
235	the cokernel of `ker q ↪ E`) it stays right exact: `g'^*(ker q) → g'^*E →
236	g'^*F → 0` is exact.  Exactness at `g'^*E` says precisely that the kernel lift
237	`g'^*(ker q) → ker (g'^* q)` — which is `pullbackKernelComparison g' q` — is an
238	epimorphism.  (The remaining monomorphism half is the genuine flat-base-change
239	content, requiring `F` flat over the base, and is handled in
240	`pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial`.) -/
241	lemma Modules.epi_pullbackKernelComparison
242	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q] :
243	    Epi (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q) := by
244	  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (Scheme.Modules.pullback g') :=
245	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g').leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
246	  have hSG := (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.exact_kernel q).map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel
247	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g') ‹Epi q› inferInstance
248	  exact hSG.epi_kernelLift

250	/-- **Basis-local criterion for monomorphisms of `𝒪_X`-modules.**  If `B` is a basis of
251	opens of `X` and `φ : M ⟶ N` is injective on sections over every basic open `B i`, then
252	`φ` is a monomorphism.  Companion of the basis-local iso criterion
253	`Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_of_isBasis` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.FlatBaseChange`):
254	basis injectivity gives stalkwise injectivity
255	(`TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis`), hence the underlying morphism of
256	sheaves of abelian groups is a monomorphism (`TopCat.Presheaf.mono_of_stalk_mono`), and the
257	faithful forgetful functor `Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf` reflects it. -/
258	theorem Modules.mono_of_injective_app_of_isBasis {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
259	    {ι : Type*} {B : ι → X.Opens} (hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis (Set.range B))
260	    (φ : M ⟶ N) (h : ∀ i, Function.Injective (φ.app (B i))) : Mono φ := by
261	  have happ : ∀ U ∈ Set.range B,
262	      Function.Injective (((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ).app (Opposite.op U)) := by
263	    rintro U ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact h i
264	  have hstalk : ∀ x : X, Function.Injective
265	      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).map ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ)) :=
266	    fun x => TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis hB happ x
267	  let MS : TopCat.Sheaf Ab.{u} X := ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩
268	  let NS : TopCat.Sheaf Ab.{u} X := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩
269	  let fS : MS ⟶ NS := ⟨(Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ⟩
270	  haveI : ∀ x, Mono ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).map fS.1) := fun x =>
271	    (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr (hstalk x)
272	  haveI hmS : Mono fS := TopCat.Presheaf.mono_of_stalk_mono fS
273	  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ) :=
274	    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.Hom.mono_iff_presheaf_mono _ _ fS).mp hmS
275	  exact (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).mono_of_mono_map ‹_›

277	/-- **The kernel–pullback comparison is an isomorphism as soon as `g'^*` keeps
278	the kernel inclusion `ker q ↪ E` monic.**  Combining the always-available
279	epimorphism half (`epi_pullbackKernelComparison`, `q` epi) with the
280	monomorphism half, `X'.Modules` being abelian (hence balanced) upgrades
281	`pullbackKernelComparison g' q` to an isomorphism: `κ` is monic because
282	`κ ≫ ker(g'^*q).ι = g'^*(ker q .ι)` (`pullbackKernelComparison_comp_ι`) is monic
283	(the hypothesis, with `ker(g'^*q).ι` monic), and epi + mono ⟹ iso.
284	
285	This isolates the *entire* remaining content of
286	`Scheme.Modules.pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial` into the single flat-base-change
287	fact `Mono (g'^*(ker q .ι))` — that the right-exact pullback preserves the
288	injection `ker q ↪ E` because the cokernel `F` is flat over the base
289	(Stacks 00HL, `Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_exact`, affine-locally through the
290	base-change section calculus). -/
291	lemma Modules.isIso_pullbackKernelComparison_of_mono
292	    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) {E F : X.Modules} (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q]
293	    (hmono : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map (Limits.kernel.ι q))) :
294	    IsIso (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q) := by
295	  haveI := Modules.epi_pullbackKernelComparison g' q
296	  haveI : Mono (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q ≫
297	      Limits.kernel.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q)) := by
298	    rw [Modules.pullbackKernelComparison_comp_ι]; exact hmono
299	  haveI : Mono (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison g' q) :=
300	    mono_of_mono _ (Limits.kernel.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map q))
301	  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi _

303	/-! ## §4. Shrinking a trivialising chart -/
304	
305	namespace LineBundle
306	
307	/-- **A trivialising chart restricts along any smaller open** (the Stacks
308	01HH chart chase of `IsLocallyTrivial.pullback`, specialised to the open
309	inclusion `V ≤ U`): if `M|_U ≅ 𝒪_U` and `V ≤ U`, then `M|_V ≅ 𝒪_V`.  The
310	witness is the `i1–i7` restriction/pullback chain along
311	`g := X.homOfLE hVU : V ⟶ U` — `g ≫ U.ι = V.ι`, so restriction to `V`
312	factors as pullback along `g` of the restriction to `U`, and the pullback of
313	the unit is the unit (`SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit`, an isomorphism
314	because `Opens.map g.base` is final). -/
315	lemma IsLocallyTrivial.trivialization_of_le {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules}
316	    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
317	    (t : M.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) :
318	    Nonempty (M.restrict V.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (V : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) := by
319	  set g : (V : Scheme) ⟶ (U : Scheme) := X.homOfLE hVU with hg_def
320	  have hgι : g ≫ U.ι = V.ι := X.homOfLE_ι hVU
321	  haveI : (TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g.base).Final :=
322	    CategoryTheory.final_of_representablyFlat _
323	  refine ⟨?_⟩
324	  -- 1: M.restrict V.ι ≅ (pullback V.ι).obj M
325	  let i1 := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι).app M
326	  -- 2: ≅ (pullback (g ≫ U.ι)).obj M  (using V.ι = g ≫ U.ι)
327	  let i2 := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hgι.symm).app M
328	  -- 3: ≅ (pullback g).obj ((pullback U.ι).obj M)
329	  let i3 := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g U.ι).symm).app M
330	  -- 4: ≅ (pullback g).obj (unit_U)  (restrict back and trivialise)
331	  let i4 := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapIso
332	    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).symm.app M ≪≫ t)
333	  -- 5: ≅ unit_V  (pullback of the unit is the unit; iso since `Opens.map
334	  -- g.base` is final)
335	  let i5 := asIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom)
336	  exact i1 ≪≫ i2 ≪≫ i3 ≪≫ i4 ≪≫ i5

338	/-- **Chart shrinking**: a locally trivial module has a trivialising *affine*
339	chart inside any open neighbourhood of any point.  Combines the defining
340	chart of `IsLocallyTrivial` with an affine shrink
341	(`exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset`) and the restriction of the
342	trivialisation (`trivialization_of_le`). -/
343	lemma IsLocallyTrivial.exists_affine_trivializing_le
344	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules} (hM : IsLocallyTrivial M)
345	    {x : X} {W : X.Opens} (hxW : x ∈ W) :
346	    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ IsAffineOpen V ∧ V ≤ W ∧
347	      Nonempty (M.restrict V.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (V : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) := by
348	  obtain ⟨U, hxU, hUaff, ⟨t⟩⟩ := hM x
349	  obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hxV, hVle⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset

8	/-!
9	# Pullback preserves quasi-coherence (Stacks 01BG, general morphism)
10	
11	For an arbitrary morphism of schemes `g : Y ⟶ X` and a quasi-coherent
12	`F : X.Modules`, the module pullback `g^* F = (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F`
13	is quasi-coherent (`pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom`).  This generalizes the
14	open-immersion case `isQuasicoherent_pullback_opens` (`CechTermAcyclic.lean`);
15	the previously-documented obstruction — `SheafOfModules.Presentation.map` only
16	transports a *global* presentation while quasi-coherence is *local* — is resolved
17	by localizing the pullback itself: over each member `U` of the quasi-coherence
18	cover of `X`, the restriction of `g^* F` to the preimage `W = g⁻¹(U)` is the
19	pullback of `F|_U` along the restricted morphism `g.resLE U W : W ⟶ U`
20	(the pullback pseudofunctor square `resLE_comp_ι`), and the *global* presentation
21	of `F|_U` transports along that restricted pullback.
22	
23	Two supporting facts are proved on the way:
24	
25	* `opensMap_final`: for any continuous map `φ`, the preimage functor
26	  `Opens.map φ` on opens is `Final` — the costructured comma poset
27	  `{U // d ≤ φ⁻¹(U)}` is nonempty (`⊤`) and `⊔`-directed, hence filtered.
28	* `pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso_hom`: consequently Mathlib's unit comparison
29	  `pullbackObjUnitToUnit` is an isomorphism for the module pullback along *any*
30	  scheme morphism, i.e. `g^* 𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y` (`pullbackUnitIso`).
31	
32	These feed the flat-base-change RHS tilde leaf
33	`pushPullObj_coverInter_baseChanged_pushforward_iso_tilde`
34	(`CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean`), which needs quasi-coherence of the
35	base-changed module `g'^* F` to apply the altitude-2 bridge
36	`pushPullObj_pushforward_iso_tilde` on the base-changed side.
37	-/
38	
39	universe u

49	/-! ## Finality of the opens-preimage functor -/
50	
51	/-- The costructured comma category `StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)` — the poset of opens
52	`U` of the target with `d ≤ φ⁻¹(U)` — is filtered: it is nonempty (`U = ⊤`) and closed
53	under binary joins (`φ⁻¹` is monotone and preserves `⊔`), and it is thin, so parallel
54	pairs are automatically equalized. -/
55	instance opensMapStructuredArrow_isFiltered {T T' : TopCat.{u}} (φ : T ⟶ T')
56	    (d : Opens T) : IsFiltered (StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)) := by
57	  haveI hne : Nonempty (StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)) :=
58	    ⟨StructuredArrow.mk (Y := ⊤) (homOfLE (fun x _ => trivial))⟩
59	  haveI hfe : IsFilteredOrEmpty (StructuredArrow d (Opens.map φ)) := by
60	    constructor
61	    · intro j₁ j₂
62	      refine ⟨StructuredArrow.mk (Y := j₁.right ⊔ j₂.right)
63	          (j₁.hom ≫ (Opens.map φ).map (homOfLE le_sup_left)),
64	        StructuredArrow.homMk (homOfLE le_sup_left) rfl,
65	        StructuredArrow.homMk (homOfLE le_sup_right) (Subsingleton.elim _ _), trivial⟩
66	    · intro j₁ j₂ f g
67	      exact ⟨j₂, 𝟙 j₂, by apply StructuredArrow.hom_ext; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
68	  constructor

70	/-- **The opens-preimage functor of any continuous map is final.**  Consequently global
71	sections of a pushforward along any scheme morphism compare correctly, and the module
72	pullback of the structure sheaf is the structure sheaf (`pullbackObjUnitToUnit` is an
73	isomorphism, Mathlib's `[F.Final]` instance in `PullbackFree.lean`). -/
74	instance opensMap_final {T T' : TopCat.{u}} (φ : T ⟶ T') : (Opens.map φ).Final :=
75	  Functor.final_of_isFiltered_structuredArrow _

77	/-- **`g^* 𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y` for an arbitrary scheme morphism**: the unit comparison of the
78	module pullback along any scheme morphism is an isomorphism (the underlying site functor
79	`Opens.map g.base` is final by `opensMap_final`). -/
80	instance pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso_hom {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) :
81	    IsIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom) :=

84	/-- The structure-sheaf unit iso `g^* 𝒪_X ≅ 𝒪_Y` for an arbitrary scheme morphism,

86	noncomputable def pullbackUnitIso {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) :
87	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅
88	      SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf :=
89	  @asIso _ _ _ _ _ (pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso_hom g)
